extracted.name: Simmered Italian Rice
extracted.description: This simmered Italian rice recipe turns plain rice into a delicious side dish when it's cooked in broth and accented with spinach and Parmesan cheese.
ingredient_lines: 1.75 cups Swanson® Chicken Broth or Swanson® Certified Organic Chicken Broth or Swanson® Natural Goodness® Chicken Broth
instruction_lines: Heat broth and Italian seasoning in a 2-quart saucepan over medium-high heat to a boil.
Stir in spinach and rice; reduce heat to low. Cover saucepan; cook until rice is tender, 20 minutes. Stir in ½ cup Parmesan cheese. Serve with additional cheese.
